numericRepresentation.wire: canonical decimal integer strings; Number and floating-point values rejected
numericRepresentation.arithmetic: BigInt only for quantities, prices, time, units, fractions and allocation checks
numericRepresentation.fractions: positive denominator, gcd-reduced, zero exactly n=0 d=1

formula.profitAndLoss: gross gain/loss retained separately; net is diagnostic only and does not authorize netting

exposure.official: intersection of the actual active quantity intervals with explicit official Epochs ending at E
exposure.gap: [E, actual close), quantity decreases applied at actual transition timestamps
independentMethods: raw transition integration by parts; no primary delta, generated intervals or intermediate sums reused
exposure.recordedComparison: explicit observed integrals required to claim recorded match; absence remains a blocker
exposure.gapMoney: always null; never inferred from integral or zero-rate fixture

funding.totals: Whole totals only when every official Epoch with positive held position exposure has obligation evidence; missing totals null, submitted subtotal separate.
funding.allocation: no implicit split over exit legs; explicit synthetic test allocation only, with exact residual
funding.realCandidate: recorded Epoch state 2 is unfinalized; official amount remains null

identity.evaluationId: domain + verified source semantic commitment + calculation version + complete explicit input/evidence
identity.rights: evaluation IDs do not create a claim, authorize settlement or consume history
identity.implementation: Execution record maps calculation version to implementation SHA-256; hashes identify bytes, not correctness.

policyInputs.calculation: null or explicitly synthetic test evidence; never approved
policyInputs.fundingAllocation: null or explicitly synthetic test allocation evidence, never approved

preservedPath: All task 2/49 input validation modules, test anchors, legacy task 2/41 path and existing tests are copied unchanged
bridgeLimits: Current trusted-input bridge supports one complete position and epochs=1; aggregate official integral comparison requires the recorded global position counter=1
Multiple official Epochs are exercised with synthetic pure-calculation inputs only
Stored Mock prices are diagnostic evidence, not approved market prices

output: NOT_EVALUATED; confirmedAmount and monetaryResult null; fundsAuthority and settlementAuthorized false; no claim or consumption records
